scope.description: Existing-record enrichment leads recovered from official company, government award, Source Book, newsletter-discovery and independent-publication lanes. Qualified leads change no organization identity and remain additive until private human review.

source.title: GE Aerospace and Magellan Aerospace Sign Memorandum of Understanding for F414 Sustainment
source.locator: Announcement, Canadian MRO scope and Government of Canada acquisition contingency
source.summary: GE Aerospace and Magellan Aerospace announced a strategic MOU to establish Canadian F414-GE-39E engine MRO capability for Gripen E aircraft, predicated on a Government of Canada acquisition decision.

leads.evidenceLocator: Official July 22 announcement and Magellan's official press-release index

aliases: GE Aerospace and Magellan F414 sustainment MOU

followUpQuestions: Does a reviewer want the MOU displayed as a partnership relationship, a current activity only, or both?
Should a future update be opened only if the Government of Canada makes the referenced Gripen acquisition decision?
reviewWarnings: The MOU is non-binding and conditional on a future Government of Canada acquisition decision; do not describe it as an awarded Canadian MRO contract.
leads.refreshSummary: A current official MOU adds a bounded partnership and current-activity update to the published Magellan Aerospace record without changing its identity or representing conditional work as an awarded contract.
intendedChanges: Add the GE Aerospace F414 sustainment MOU as a public relationship.
Add qualified current-activity and evidence-boundary text to Magellan profile data.

source.title: Government of Canada Awards Victoria In-Service Support Contract Extension to Babcock Canada
source.locator: Company-issued announcement of the six-year Victoria In-Service Support Contract extension
source.summary: Babcock Canada announced a six-year extension to continue its Victoria In-Service Support Contract role for the Royal Canadian Navy's Victoria-class fleet.

leads.evidenceLocator: Babcock Canada announcement, CanadaBuys contract history and independent Canadian Press report
followUpQuestions: Should the contract extension be represented as a nested current program/activity or only as profile metadata?
If a future authoritative award notice publishes a formal value or term, should it replace the reported independent-publication amount?
reviewWarnings: The CanadaBuys history record provides public contract context but does not itself reproduce the July 20 extension wording; the proposed extension details retain company-issued and Canadian Press provenance.
leads.refreshSummary: The published Babcock Canada record already covers Victoria-class sustainment. The current contract extension adds time-bounded, public activity context and a nested VISSC activity without replacing the existing stable capability.
intendedChanges: Add the Victoria In-Service Support Contract extension as a nested public activity.
Update Babcock profile_data with the current six-year extension and a provenance boundary.
